text: Dax, the tribe, extended itself wellward of Judah, and was permitted by Azotus and Dora on the Medi- terminom (Jofaphay).

parsed.faithful: DAN, the tribe, extended itself westward of Judah, and was terminated by Azotus and Dora on the Mediterranean (Joppekus).
